title: Seated easy stretches
intro: No twisting and no forward folds. Just easy stretches while you stay in your chair.

moves.name: Sit tall
steps: Place your feet flat on the floor.
Imagine a string lifting the top of your head.
Let your shoulders settle and breathe slowly.

moves.name: Arms overhead
steps: Breathe in and lift both arms up in front of you.
Reach toward the ceiling, only as high as is comfortable.

moves.name: Gentle side reach
steps: Rest one hand on the seat beside you.
Reach the other arm up and gently over, keeping your hips still.
Come back to centre, then switch sides.

moves.name: Open the chest
steps: Clasp your hands behind your back, or hold the sides of the chair.
Ease your shoulder blades slightly toward each other.
Keep your chin level and breathe easily.

moves.name: Seat marching
steps: Sit tall with your hands on your thighs.
Lift one knee a little, set it down, then the other.

moves.name: Ankle circles
steps: Lift one foot slightly off the floor.
Draw slow circles with your toes.
Switch direction halfway, then change feet.

closing: That is the set. Your chair is all you needed.
wayOut: Stop if anything feels uncomfortable, and skip any move that does not suit you.
